methodologyNotes: This dataset covers thirteen high-search wearable, electric double, and portable breast pump models as of mid-2026. Primary sources are manufacturer product pages (elvie.com, onewillow.com, spectrababyusa.com, momcozy.com, babybuddhaproducts.com, pumpables.co) plus Target/Babylist/Save Rite Medical retail listings and authoritative review/clinical corroboration (BabyGearLab, WhichBreastPump, Lucie's List, Exclusive Pumping). Prices reflect publicly listed MSRP or current buy-now price in USD; boolean specs (rechargeable_battery, hospital_grade, closed_system) are true when the manufacturer or a medical review explicitly applies the label, false when explicitly denied, and null when neither confirmed nor denied. Weight is recorded per pump unit or motor (not packaging) in ounces, converted from manufacturer-stated grams where needed (1 g ≈ 0.0353 oz). All values independently re-verified 2026-06-19 against the cited primary/retail sources. accessedAt 2026-06-19.
